scope: finite authored geometric prerequisite; five poses are not five unique tests or continuous-motion certification

bounds.scope: conservative union of both endpoint bounds for pure tray translation; framing/placement envelope only

drawer.scope: five finite pure-translation poses; actual bounds, guide engagement, support contact, stop gaps, root soles and triangle rays; no continuous safety, real player motion, hand fit, load or friction proof

attachments.method: actual transformed closed-solid vertex parity/point-to-triangle contact, then segment-to-triangle and edge-pair contact; all mesh pairs have a full-bounds broad phase only
attachments.scope: spatial contact graph at closed/open endpoints, including all named parts; no fastener strength, load, friction or continuous motion claim

originalSpriteEnvelopeClearance.method: sphere enclosing all four full raw Sprite quad corners from actual world scale/center; sphere-to-conservative-3D-pose-envelope distance; includes faint/transparent corners without cropping

meadowInstances.scope: every actual current meadow instance geometry AABB transformed by its actual instance and world matrix, expanded .018 in all axes; current finite matrices and authored animation allowance, no all-frame proof

shoreline.method: every actual dry-land boundary segment against full projected rectangle, including crossing and endpoint/corner distances

waterBacking.scope: actual wet backing under dry land, no water physics

placement.limits: one unchanged current default-world off-road authored placement,20 round-foot support rays,finite footprint walkability,actual road triangles and conservative full-card envelopes; whole bounded drawer-sweep placement envelope; no owner-world placement, anatomical fit or all-camera visibility guarantee
